source_policy: Exact source file and normalized text hashes are preserved.
Decision records, General Session principled stances and Division legal opinions retain distinct authority kinds.
Collection V publication binding is not equivalent to remote/original-decision binding.
Every item is historical and requires current-law verification before present-law reliance.
No party identities are expanded or deanonymized beyond the supplied source.
No ECLI, URL, treatment, current-law status or binding force is invented.
